capabilities: Add, update and delete YAML properties and inline Dataview fields
Define Auto Properties with pre-defined selectable values
Auto-update progress properties from task completion counts
Rename body #tags and edit frontmatter tags lists
Expose an API for other plugins and Templater templates
disambiguation: Not a metadata viewer or query tool; it edits property values rather than displaying or searching them.
extras: Full documentation lives at metaedit.obsidian.guide; API examples for task completion require Dataview, Templater or Buttons, and the docs state explicitly which actions (vault-wide tag rename, frontmatter tag widget) are left to Obsidian itself.
problem: Obsidian has no convenient way to edit frontmatter properties, inline Dataview fields or tags in place without manually opening and rewriting YAML.
